title: Unit Event — The Stopped Hand Moves Once More

meta.Event: The Stopped Hand Moves Once More
meta.Outline: Mafuyu resolves to face her mother and tell her how she truly feels. At the same time, her mother swears to value Mafuyu's wishes over anything else. The two finally meet again and open up...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: You're gonna talk to your mom tomorrow, after all. I'd be nervous too.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
That's understandable.
Especially since she wasn't willing to see things from your side the last time you spoke to her.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Stop it, Luka.
You're just making her more anxious.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: She's finally trying to move forward. Don't get in her way.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Oh, that's quite a strong reaction from you two.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: I've already made up my mind.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
There's something I wanna give you, Mafuyu!
Can you stretch out your hand for me?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Yup! I made some for us the other day.
I thought we could all wear them.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Unlike Kanade, we can't be there when you talk to her, right?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: So, I thought these would help make it feel like we're there with you in spirit.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Is it a key to something?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: You didn't drop it, right, Mafuyu?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: What if it goes to the door at the lake?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: That's right. We still haven't been able to open that door.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: If it really does go to that door, then does that mean we can open it now?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: What do you think we're gonna see when we open it?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: It's gotta be connected to a strange, new place! Like a portal to another world!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Seriously, where do you get these ideas?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Still, I am looking forward to seeing what's on the other side.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: (If what I see on the other side is...)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
*Nod*
I think that's for the best.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Right, this is your SEKAI, after all.
You should open that door when you feel comfortable.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: It's not like you absolutely have to open it right this second. You can think about it more after things have settled down.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: For now...I just want to focus on tomorrow.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Father
rows.Line:
You're still awake?
Shouldn't you get to bed soon? We have an early day tomorrow.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Father
rows.Line:
Don't worry.
We discussed this the other day, remember?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Father
rows.Line: We'll talk to Mafuyu, hear her out, and respect what she's feeling. For the sake of her happiness.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Father
rows.Line: As long as we do that, everything should go just fine.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line: I want to be there for her...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Father
rows.Line: Thank you for coming today, Mafuyu.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line:
It's been so long, Mafuyu...
How have you been? Good?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line: Umm... Are you by chance not feeling very well? If you aren't, you don't have to...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: This is how I normally am.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line:
You don't have to apologize, Mafuyu.
I'm the one who should apologize.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line:
The thing is...
There's something I need to tell you today, Mafuyu.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line:
After everything... Since you left home...
I've been thinking.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line:
That day, I... No, all this time...
I think I must have hurt you very badly.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line: I'd always believed that you dreamed of becoming a doctor... I had things all wrong this whole time...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line: And because of that, I ended up making you suffer a great deal.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line: I thought focus and discipline now would pay off in your future prospects, and pushed my own feelings on you...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line:
But now...
I just want you to be happy, Mafuyu.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line: I know that may be hard for you to believe...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
I know you're a kind person, Mom...
I know you're always thinking about what's best for me.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
I've known that forever...
And that feeling hasn't changed.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Every time you told me I ought to do this or that...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
I know you had my best interests in mind...
But I felt like I was being slowly crushed.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
Even at home, I couldn't relax...
It's like I didn't belong anywhere...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: I don't expect you to apologize or change for me. That's not what I want.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: I... I just want you to understand how I feel.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line:
I'm sorry...
I didn't mean to make you feel that way.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line: I truly have hurt you, haven't I?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line: I thought long and hard about how I can make you truly happy, Mafuyu.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line: I've decided to support you with what you really want to do.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line: If your dream isn't to become a doctor, then you don't have to become one.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line: It's also okay if you don't quite know what you want to do yet.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line: You can take all the time you need to think about your future... While doing whatever you'd like to do now.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line:
Yes, of course.
I just want you to be yourself, Mafuyu.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (The last time I spoke to Mafuyu's mom, she really didn't seem to have her daughter's best interests in mind.)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (But she doesn't feel that way anymore.)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line:
Mafuyu...
Can you tell me how things have been for you recently?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line:
Oh, you don't have to if you're not comfortable.
It's just...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line:
We haven't spoken in so long.
I wanted to hear how you were doing.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: But when it was cold outside, I did use the scarf you gave me, Mom...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line: Thank you for telling us all this, Mafuyu.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line: I'm so glad that we had this chance to talk. I mean, it'd just been so long...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Father
rows.Line: Thank you for agreeing to do this today.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Father
rows.Line: I'm glad that you were able to hear what Mafuyu had to say and have an actual conversation with her, honey.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Father
rows.Line: Now, about us as a family moving forward...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Father
rows.Line: Mafuyu, if you feel ready to come home, then we'd love to have you back.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Father
rows.Line: Just as your mother said, we want to respect your choices above all else moving forward.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Father
rows.Line: We plan on doing our best to make sure you feel like you belong at home. Both of us...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Father
rows.Line: But if you're still not ready to come home, then we'll be more than happy to keep waiting.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Father
rows.Line: So, Mafuyu, we want you to decide.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: (Am I ready to go back home...?)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: (I'm still a little scared to, but...)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: (I want to believe in Mom and Dad.)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: (I want to believe that warmth I felt just now was real.)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line: I really need to apologize to you again for all the trouble we caused you, Ms. Yoisaki. And thank you very much...for being there for her.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: No... It really wasn't anything much...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Do you need any help, Mafuyu?
I'm free to lend you a hand.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
No, that's mostly everything.
I didn't actually bring that many things over.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: I'll carry these down once my dad gets here.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Things are going to feel quiet here without you.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Oh, sorry... I'm happy that you're ready to go home now, Mafuyu.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: But I've also sort of gotten used to having you around.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I'm a little sad that you're leaving.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: I'll come back again from time to time.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Because you might push yourself too hard and forget to eat again.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Huh? N-No, I'll be fine.
What I did was bad, and I've learned my lesson.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: If you don't eat properly, then I'm going to tell Mochizuki.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Miku, Len. We didn't see you there.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <M-Mafuyu... We heard that you're going home today.>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Yes, my dad should be here soon to pick me up.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <I'm just a little worried is all.>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: I want to believe what my mom said.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
I hear a car coming.
That must be your dad.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Father
rows.Line:
Alright, we're here.
I'll carry your things for you.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Father
rows.Line: You can open the door when you feel ready, Mafuyu.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: (You made the decision to believe in Mom.)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line:
Please, come in.
Dinner is just about ready.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Father
rows.Line: Oh, look at all the dishes on the dining table. We must be having a feast tonight.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line: Hehe. I couldn't help it, since I knew Mafuyu was finally coming home.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line: Okay, let's get your things settled and have dinner once everything is ready.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line:
So, once again...
Welcome home, Mafuyu!

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line: Today's menu includes many of your favorite dishes. I made them just for you.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line: I gave them some extra seasoning compared to normal. I hope you'll like them.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Father
rows.Line:
Everything looks delicious...
I think I'll start with some of these cabbage rolls.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line: Hehe. Those turned out very nicely.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line: Let me know if you're not able to reach something, Mafuyu. I'll pass it to you.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line: Oh, but there's just so much to choose from, isn't there?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line: How about this? I was able to buy some very fresh snapper today, so I decided to sauté it. Give it a try.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line:
Oh, I'm sorry.
Please choose whatever you like, Mafuyu.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Father
rows.Line: I think we're all just excited about Mafuyu coming home.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line:
Yes, I think so...
I'll have to mind myself.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Then, I'll have the snapper sauté.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line:
Okay.
I'll put it on your plate now.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Father
rows.Line: Anyway, since it's been so long, let's take this opportunity to catch up with each other.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line: Yes! I'd love to hear about what you've been doing at school lately, Mafuyu.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line: Hehe. Still, Mafuyu, I had no idea that you helped put on a test of courage. I would've loved to see you at work.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Father
rows.Line: Me too. I'm still having trouble picturing you as a cat monster, but I'm sure you looked very cute.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
Thanks for breakfast.
I should start heading over to school.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line:
Okay, be safe.
And good luck at school, Mafuyu.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: (Mom and I ended up talking a lot yesterday.)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: (Which made my chest feel so warm.)

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <We came to see how you were doing.>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: At least, I think I'm fine.

rows.Speaker: Teacher
rows.Line:
Here you are, Asahina.
I thought your essay this time around was very good.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
Thank you very much.
I'm glad to hear it, since I did try my best on this one.

rows.Speaker: Teacher
rows.Line: Would it be alright if I posted this up for everyone to have a look at?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line:
Oh, welcome home.
Dinner will be ready in just a moment.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line:
Huh? Oh, you got a 98?
That's wonderful!

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line:
Well done, Mafuyu.
That's your hard work paying off. Congratulations.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line: Is this the song you and your friends are working on at the moment?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line:
You're the lyricist for your group, yes?
Can you tell me how you came up with the words for this one?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
I don't know.
I just write down what I feel.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line: Then, these are the things you've been feeling.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line: Would it be alright if I listened to some of your other songs?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Hi, Asahina!
I have a question about that class rep meeting!

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
Is this about that survey?
I was actually hoping to discuss that with you a little further.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Hehe. Then, let's talk about it right now!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <Mafuyu seems to be feeling a lot better now...>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line:
Good morning.
Oh, I thought you didn't have school today?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line: I was actually hoping to invite you to that Vermeer exhibit.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
I'm sorry.
We still have club activities today...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line: Oh... I didn't realize you were still doing that.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line:
Oh... I-I'm sorry.
I didn't mean it like that.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: I'd like to continue until I have to leave to focus on preparing for my entrance exams...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line:
Yes, of course.
There's no problem with that at all!

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line: I know. Since you have club today, I'll go get some towels and such ready for you.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line:
Nonsense. You stay put.
I'll be right back with everything.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line: Oh... I didn't realize you were still doing that.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: (She said that it's okay for me to, but...)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line:
Welcome home, Mafuyu.
How was your club?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: We had an instructor from the archery federation come and teach us today.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line:
An instructor from the federation?
That's incredible!

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line: Hehe. I went to that exhibit I mentioned, and it was very good.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line: Viewing masterpieces really does have a way of refining your taste.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line:
We should go together sometime.
Of course, on a day when you don't have club activities.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line:
Ah, it's from your father.
He says his meeting ended early, so he'll be home in time for dinner tonight.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line: Hehe. I'll need to get started right away.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
Since I'm free, I'd like to help...
Would that be alright?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line: Let's surprise your father by preparing a delicious feast for him!

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Father
rows.Line:
Oh, this mapo tofu's good.
It has a nice kick to it.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line:
Hehe. I'm glad you like it.
Mafuyu helped me make it today.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Father
rows.Line:
Thank you, Mafuyu.
This is delicious.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line: I'm so glad that we're able to spend time together like this again.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Father
rows.Line:
Yes, me too.
It's certainly made everything feel brighter.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line: I realized something now that we're living together again...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line: I really didn't know anything about you, Mafuyu.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line: I'm so impressed by the way you're doing your best with school, club and your hobby.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line: You even did well on that test the other day. You must be putting in more effort than even I'm aware of.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line: I feel that you have the power to succeed at anything you choose to do.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
I'm really not that special...
But thank you.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line: That reminds me. You mentioned that you wished to do something that allows you to be there for people, yes?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line: Then, maybe we ought to start looking for schools for you.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line: Based on your academic level, you should be able to get into any school you like, no?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: But I want to keep thinking it over...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Father
rows.Line: Why don't we talk about this some other time, honey?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line: I'm so sorry. I did it again...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line: It's also okay if you don't quite know what you want to do yet.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line: You can take all the time you need to think about your future... While doing whatever you'd like to do now.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: (All Mom did was make a small suggestion, for my sake.)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: I should get something to drink.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line: I thought I made it clear to myself that I'd respect Mafuyu's feelings...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line: Mafuyu said it was okay, but...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Father
rows.Line:
It's okay...
Try not to beat yourself up.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <She said that she's gonna stay muted to focus on what she's working on, remember?>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <I was wondering if it was okay for me to contact her.>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
<I wouldn't know.
Why don't you send her a message in chat?>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
<Huh? Oh, right...
I forgot that you're back home now.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <Sorry, I keep thinking that you're still at her place.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Haha. To be fair, she was there for a while.>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: <I'm going to go get something to drink...>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line:
I-I'm sorry.
I was just a little worried, since it's already two in the morning...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line: I'll be awake for a little while longer, so please let me know if you'd like a midnight snack.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line:
Oh, welcome home.
How did things go at school today?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
Not much happened...
Oh, but I did get that math test back.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line:
Oh...
You didn't score as well as you did last time.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line: You must just be feeling a bit fatigued.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line:
But you just have to work harder and make it up next time.
Don't worry, I know you will, Mafuyu.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
Mom, I finished vacuuming everything.
I'll start dusting the shelves next.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line: Thank you! I really appreciate it!

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: (What are all these college pamphlets doing here? Are these for...?)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line: Then, maybe we ought to start looking for schools for you.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: (I don't feel at home in that house...)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: (I want to believe in her, but...)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line:
Yes... Yes...
I understand. Then, we'll talk again next Sunday.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line:
I see.
So, that call was...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line: After discussing things with your father, I've begun seeing a therapist.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line: I've been having trouble doing some of the things that I've been asked...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line: I know that I shouldn't rob you of your freedom, and yet...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line: But I promise to do my best...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line: I'll work hard to make this house a warm place for you to come home to...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line:
I'm sorry. I know you must be worried...
But you don't have to mind me.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line: Anyway, I need to start making dinner.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: (I didn't realize Mom was suffering this much.)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: (She ran herself ragged trying to figure out what to do...)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line:
Umm...
I was just looking up some schools that I thought you'd be interested in attending. If you might want to become a nurse, that is...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line:
I'm sorry for not asking you first.
But... I just want to help you...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Thank you. I'll take a look at these later...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line: Really? Then, please let me know if any catch your interest.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line:
I actually really liked this one.
I was very impressed by the facilities and curriculum. What do you think?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line: I can gather more information on it if you like. I'll even find you the right study guide...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line:
Oh, I'm sorry.
I keep jumping ahead before you've even made a decision.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Thank you for doing all this for me.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line: You're welcome! I hope you'll keep allowing me to help make your dream come true...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: (She's putting herself through so much for my sake...)

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: (I wonder what Mafuyu's doing right now...)

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: (Maybe she's listening to her music with her mom again.)

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: (When I heard that Mafuyu would be going home, I was a little worried...)

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: But I'm glad she's patched things up with her mom.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
You don't look so good...
Did something happen...?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: I want to stay here for a little while...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (I have a good feeling about this demo.)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Now...
I feel like I can compose a song which captures the warmth Mafuyu told us about.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I need to focus and make that happen...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
What's wrong?
It's not like you to suddenly visit like this.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <What's up? Did you have a lot of homework to do or something?>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <You're about the only one who'd let that happen to yourself, Amia.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <What?! You have days like that too, right, Yuki?!>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
(What's going on?
She seemed to be doing a little better recently.)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line:
<Look, Mafuyu.
The school we just talked about is holding an open house next month.>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line: <Why don't we go together? What do you say?>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line:
<Thank goodness...!
I'm very much looking forward to going.>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line: <I hope it's a place where you can study exactly what you like.>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (Does this mean Mafuyu knows which school she wants to attend? But she didn't sound all that excited.)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (I can't put my finger on it, but something feels wrong here.)

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
<S-So...
When Mafuyu came over to SEKAI earlier, she looked like she was in a lot of pain.>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line:
<Huh?
Oh, are you working with your group?>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line:
<Anyway, I'll excuse myself here.
Don't stay up too late, okay, Mafuyu?>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <What do you mean? So, you don't want to go?>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (How did things return to the way they were...?)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (But things can't go on like this.)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Father
rows.Line: Thank you very much for coming all this way to join us today, Ms. Yoisaki.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Father
rows.Line: And I apologize for not thanking you properly yet for looking after our daughter.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Oh, no...
Thank you for inviting me to have dinner with you, after I contacted you on such short notice...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line:
That's not a problem.
If anything, I'm glad that you contacted us.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line: I put quite a lot of effort into tonight's dinner, so please have as much as you like.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Father
rows.Line: Please allow me to thank you again, Ms. Yoisaki.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Father
rows.Line: Ever since Mafuyu came home, this house feels like it's been brought back to life. We really couldn't be happier...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Father
rows.Line: None of this would've been possible if you hadn't been there for Mafuyu during her time of need, Ms. Yoisaki.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I think Mafuyu deserves more credit for making the decision to stand back up and move forward...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Father
rows.Line: We need to thank you as well, Mafuyu.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line: I'm so glad that we get to spend time together as a family again like this, Mafuyu.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line: I've slowly been getting to know you, and I get to help you with your future again...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line: Is something the matter, Ms. Yoisaki?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Umm... I overheard you talking the other day about a school Mafuyu is thinking about attending.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Father
rows.Line:
She already has a school picked out?
This is news to me...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line: Hehe. We just talked about it the other day, so I hadn't had a chance to tell you yet, dear.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line: The thing is, I found this wonderful school, and Mafuyu and I will be attending their open house together.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Father
rows.Line: Wasn't Mafuyu saying just recently she wanted some time to think about her dream on her own?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Father
rows.Line: And now she's already decided even the school she wants to go to?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line: Hehe. I've actually been gathering information on schools which would suit Mafuyu, so that she would have an easier time choosing.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line: And Mafuyu's taken an interest in one of them.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Do you really want to attend this school?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Father
rows.Line: If there's something you'd like to say, Mafuyu, then would you tell us?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Father
rows.Line: I'm sorry if I'm jumping to the wrong conclusion, but...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Father
rows.Line: Something tells me that your feelings aren't entirely genuine.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Father
rows.Line:
It's okay. We're family.
You're always free to tell us how you really feel, Mafuyu.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line: Umm... I'm not sure I understand...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line: You said you wanted to go... Didn't you, Mafuyu?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line: You said you liked that school...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line: That open house... You said you were interested in going...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line: Did I misjudge how you were feeling...?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Father
rows.Line: It's okay. Try to take a deep breath...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line: But I was so sure that I was helping Mafuyu achieve her dream this time around...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line: I ended up making you suffer again...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: I'm so sorry! I was just...!

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: It's my fault for not speaking up... So...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line:
I'm sorry.
You don't have to apologize, Mafuyu.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line:
Look at me. What am I doing?
Causing you trouble like this again...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line: I didn't mean to ruin our dinner like this.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line: I'm just going to use the restroom for a bit.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: I stayed quiet and didn't tell her how I feel, because I didn't want to hurt her...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: But I ended up doing that anyway...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Father
rows.Line:
She's right. It's all just a little miscommunication.
So—

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: It's my fault. It's all my fault that Mom's...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
(What do I do...?
She can't seem to hear anything Mr. Asahina or I are saying.)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Father
rows.Line: I'm sorry about all this. If possible, I hope you'll let me call on you again in a few days' time...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (When I last met with them, Mafuyu's mom seemed to actually be thinking about her daughter...)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Father
rows.Line:
I'm truly sorry...
I didn't mean for this to happen again.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: No, you don't need to apologize to me...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Father
rows.Line: Thank you. And I greatly appreciate your generosity...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Father
rows.Line: Unfortunately, this appears to be the only place right now where Mafuyu can actually feel at ease.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Father
rows.Line: So, until things settle down... We'll be leaving her in your care.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Father
rows.Line: Mafuyu? Once things have settled, I'll reach out again. Okay?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Father
rows.Line:
Then, if you'll excuse me.
And once again... I'm very sorry.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Why do I keep hurting my mom...?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: It's all my fault... I'm the reason she's suffering...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: What am I supposed to do...?
